ayahOccurrences.text: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: قَصَمْنَا is in the derivative form: قَصَمَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/ص/م   q–ṣ–m to break, to shatter, to snap; to be brittle; catastrophe. Of this root, قَصَمَ qaṣama occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قَصَمَ qaṣama i [v. trans.] to totally demolish, to shatter

(21:11) وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً how many a community of evildoers We have shattered.
